app.name: Print Server
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the account given to you by the administrator.
setup.title: First-time setup
setup.intro: No administrator exists yet. Create the first administrator account. This page only works from the server PC itself.
setup.remote: Initial setup is only allowed from the server PC (http://127.0.0.1:5000/setup) or with the command below, run in the project folder on the server.
error.title: Something went wrong
account.title: My account
account.password_rules: At least 10 characters; must not be the same as the username.
account.must_change: You must set a new password before continuing.
print.title: Print
print.drop_here: Tap to choose files or drop them here (several at once is fine)
print.preview_empty: Upload a file to see the preview.
print.preview_disclaimer: Layout preview of the sheet: grey = area the printer cannot print, red dashed line = printable area. Colours on paper depend on the media and ink.
print.note_sheets: {pages} page(s) → {sheets} sheet(s) per copy, {physical} sheet(s) in total
print.note_estimated: Printable area is estimated (printer driver not reachable right now).
print.note_clipped: At 100% size part of the content falls outside the printable area and will be cut off.
opt.borderless_note: Borderless slightly enlarges the image past the paper edges. Edge-to-edge results depend on paper type and are not guaranteed.
status.reason.spooler_down: The Windows Print Spooler service is not running or not responding.
status.reason.printer_missing: The printer is not installed or cannot be opened on the server.
status.reason.win_paused: The Windows print queue is paused.
status.reason.app_paused: The print queue has been paused by an administrator.
status.reason.printer_reports_problem: The printer reports a problem (offline, out of paper, error or needs attention).
status.reason.jobs_waiting: A job is waiting — check that the printer is switched on, connected by USB and has paper.
status.reason.usb_not_detected: The printer's USB connection is not detected by the server.
status.reason.ready_evidence: Print service running, queue empty and printer USB connection detected.
status.reason.idle_unverified: Queue is empty. The physical printer connection can only be confirmed when a job prints.
status.reason.work_offline: Windows has 'Use printer offline' switched on for this printer.
history.title: My print jobs
jobs.confirm_cancel: Cancel this job? Pages already sent to the printer may still be printed.
admin.ev.win_status_note: On this Epson, status 0 is also reported when USB is disconnected, so 0 is never treated as 'ready'.
admin.ev.usb_note: Supplementary check (Plug and Play, Epson vendor ID); does not guarantee paper/ink readiness.
admin.confirm_cancel_all: Cancel ALL unfinished jobs of all users?
maint.pause_note: Pausing the application queue keeps new jobs here (they can still be cancelled cleanly). Pausing the Windows queue holds jobs already sent to Windows.
maint.confirm_purge: Delete EVERY job in the Windows queue for this printer, including jobs from other programs?
maint.confirm_spooler: Restart the Windows Print Spooler service now? Jobs currently in the Windows queue may be lost.
maint.spooler_note: Jobs that were in the Windows queue during a restart are marked 'Outcome unknown'. Jobs still in the application queue are sent afterwards.
maint.confirm_test: Print one A4 test page on plain paper?
maint.test_note: One A4 sheet, draft quality, 100% size. The square must measure exactly 100 × 100 mm.
maint.dialogs_remote: Windows dialogs can only open on the server's own desktop and not while the app runs as a Windows service. Run one of these commands on the server:
maint.preferences_note: Changes made in Printing preferences alter the printer's defaults. Jobs from this website always set paper, type, quality, colour, orientation and copies themselves.
maint.windows_queue_note: Live view of the Windows spooler queue (EnumJobs), including jobs from other programs.
maint.confirm_cancel_windows: Delete this job from the Windows queue?
maint.name: Name
maint.devmode_note: Read-only. The application never writes the printer defaults and never edits Epson private driver data.
maint.paper_check_note: Verified PaperSize values from the Epson investigation compared with what the installed driver currently advertises. Borderless is offered only when the driver lists a matching borderless size and it is enabled in Settings.
users.username_rules: 3–32 characters: Latin letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
set.borderless_note: Only for paper sizes whose borderless version is advertised by the driver (see Printer page). Verify on paper before enabling.
set.copies_mode_note: Driver mode uses the verified standard Copies and Collate fields.
set.devmode_merge_note: Off (default) = exactly the physically verified path from the specification: printer DEVMODE + standard fields → CreateDC. On = additionally lets the Epson driver reconcile its internal settings (standard Windows DocumentProperties call). Use the Driver check with both settings on site before changing this.
set.pdf_render_dpi_note: Maximum resolution PDF pages are rendered at before being sent to the printer.
set.default_image_dpi_note: Used for Actual size when an image has no resolution information.
set.spooler_retry_minutes: Keep retrying while the spooler is unavailable (minutes)
set.max_inflight_spooler_jobs: Jobs sent to Windows at the same time
set.inflight_note: 1 keeps later jobs in the application queue, where cancellation is always clean.
set.server_note: These values are read from config.json when the service starts.
sim.banner: SIMULATED PRINTER — development mode, nothing is sent to a real printer.
js.cancel_cancelling: Cancellation requested; the job is being removed.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.too_large: The file is too large (limit {max_mb} MB).
err.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minute(s).
err.internal: An internal error occurred. The administrator can find details in the system log.
err.csrf: Your session has expired. Reload the page and try again.
err.network: Cannot reach the print server. Check your network connection.
err.login_failed: Wrong username or password, or the account is disabled.
err.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported. Use PDF or an image (JPEG, PNG…).
err.corrupt_file: The file is damaged or cannot be read.
err.image_too_large: The image has too many pixels to process safely.
err.pdf_unavailable: PDF support is not installed on the server.
err.pdf_corrupt: The PDF is damaged or cannot be read.
err.pdf_encrypted: The PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and try again.
err.pdf_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages (limit {max_pages}).
err.pdf_render: A PDF page could not be rendered.
err.render_failed: The document could not be prepared for printing.
err.upload_expired: The uploaded file has expired. Please upload it again.
err.file_missing: The job's file is no longer available.
err.invalid_options: Some print settings are not valid.
err.custom_size: Custom size must be width {min_w}–{max_w} mm and height {min_h}–{max_h} mm.
err.paper_unavailable: This paper size is not currently offered by the printer driver.
err.margins: Margins must be 0–50 mm and leave room to print.
err.nup_actual: Actual size cannot be combined with several pages per sheet.
err.borderless_unavailable: Borderless printing is not available for this paper size.
err.too_many_jobs: You have too many unfinished jobs. Wait for them to finish or cancel some.
err.printer_not_found: The printer is not available on the server.
err.spooler_unavailable: The Windows print service is not available.
err.printer_busy: The printer is busy; try again in a moment.
err.printer_dc_failed: The printer driver could not start the job.
err.access_denied: Windows denied access to the printer (administrator rights needed).
err.cancel_failed: The job could not be cancelled.
err.spooler_job_gone: The job is no longer in the Windows queue.
err.spooler_restart_failed: The Print Spooler could not be restarted.
err.server_restarted: The server restarted while this job was being prepared. Please print it again.
err.properties_remote: Windows dialogs can only be opened on the server's own desktop.
err.invalid_settings: Some settings are not valid; nothing was saved.
err.username_invalid: Username must be 3–32 characters: Latin letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
err.password_is_username: Password must not be the same as the username.
err.password_same: The new password must be different.
err.last_admin: The last active administrator cannot be disabled or demoted.
err.cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
err.cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove your own administrator role.
maint.driver_check_note: Builds the settings of every verified paper size and every paper type × quality exactly like a real job, lets the Epson driver validate them and reads the printable area. No print job is created and no paper is used. Takes up to a minute.
maint.driver_check_summary: Driver validation {merge}: {adjusted} setting(s) changed by the driver, {mismatches} paper size mismatch(es), {errors} error(s).
err.password_change_required: You must change your password before continuing.
err.no_pages_selected: Select at least one page in every document (or remove the document).
err.office_busy: The Word/Excel converter is busy. Try again in a minute.
err.office_corrupt: The Word/Excel file is damaged or cannot be read.
err.office_encrypted: The Word/Excel file is password-protected. Remove the password and try again.
err.office_external: The document links to external files or templates, which is not allowed. Save it without external links (or as PDF) and try again.
err.office_failed: The Word/Excel file could not be converted for printing. Save it as PDF and try again.
err.office_macros: Documents with macros cannot be printed. Save it as a normal .docx/.xlsx (or PDF).
err.office_timeout: Converting the Word/Excel file took too long. Try a smaller file or save it as PDF.
err.office_unavailable: Word/Excel printing is not available on this server right now. Save the file as PDF, or ask the administrator.
err.preset_name: Enter a name for the preset.
err.print_name_invalid: Enter your name: 2–40 letters or digits (spaces, dots, dashes and apostrophes allowed).
err.too_many_documents: Too many documents in one job (maximum {max}).
err.too_many_presets: Too many presets (maximum {max}). Delete one first.
login.name_only_hint: Signed in with a name only (no password). This name is recorded in the job history.
login.name_subtitle: Enter your name. It is shown in the print history. No password is needed for printing.
office.admin_hint: Word/Excel files are rejected until a converter is available: install Microsoft Office (Word and Excel) or LibreOffice on this PC, set "office_converter" in config.json if needed, restart the service, then press "Test conversion".
office.reason.no_libreoffice: LibreOffice not found (check libreoffice_path in config.json)
office.reason.none_installed: neither Microsoft Office nor LibreOffice is installed
office.service_note: Microsoft Office runs here inside a Windows service. Microsoft does not officially support this; use "Test conversion" to confirm it works, or switch to LibreOffice (office_converter = libreoffice).
office.test_ok: converted with {engine} in {ms} ms, {pages} page(s). Nothing was printed.
office.title: Word / Excel conversion
pages.thumbs: Pages – click to select or deselect (Shift+click selects a span)
preset.label: Print preset
preset.name_prompt: Name for this preset (current settings will be saved):
preset.share_confirm: Share this preset with all users? (Cancel = only for you)
print.office_unavailable: {types}: currently not available on this server – save as PDF instead.
print.order_hint: Documents print in this order. Drag ⋮⋮ or use ↑ ↓ to change it.
print.processing: Checking {name}… (Word/Excel files are converted, this can take a moment)
set.user_login_mode: How users identify themselves for printing
set.user_login_mode_note: "Name only": users type a name (recorded in history) without a password; anyone can type any name. The admin panel always requires an account with a password.
